en.gameDesc: Convert a context-free grammar to Chomsky Normal Form step by step: remove Λ-productions, eliminate unit productions, and rewrite remaining rules.

af.gameDesc: Skakel 'n konteksvrye grammatika stap vir stap om na Chomsky Normaalvorm: verwyder Λ-produksies, elimineer eenheidsproduksies, en herskryf oorblywende reëls.

zu.gameDesc: Guqula igramathiki engena-konteksi ibe yi-Chomsky Normal Form isinyathelo ngesinyathelo: susa ama-Λ-production, qeda ama-unit production, bese ubhala kabusha imithetho esele.
